test_item_verbatim: From the AUX Cam settings menu, the user presses “Edit Name”.

tcs.tc_title: pressing Edit Name from the AUX Cam settings menu starts the name edit
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. The individual AUX Cam settings pop-up for the wired camera is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "Edit Name" soft control
2. Read the HU display and check that the name edit has started
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Edit Name" soft control registers the press
2. The pop-up updates to show the name edit
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: pressing Edit Name from the AUX Cam settings menu starts the name edit
tcs.test_item:
From the AUX Cam settings menu, the user presses “Edit Name”.

(pressing Edit Name from the AUX Cam settings menu starts the name edit)

reasoning: §31 之父題逐字為 `Editing a camera name- Camera App`，§31.1 為 `Editing AUX Cam Name`。本列為該流程之起點；鍵盤之內容由 `-149`（§31.1.2）承接。與 `-129`／`-135`（§29.1.2／§29.2.2 之 `Edit the name`）之分工：後兩者只驗該項**被提供**，本列為**流程之起點**；三列之來源列皆不同（**R-CAM10**）。
